race.comment: CAPTURE ME (1) progressive gelding ready to win. Bounced off his good first-up third in town with a tough on-pace second over 1100m at Warwick Farm. Set to peak from the low draw in this weaker race. NAFANUA (7) nice filly resuming. Expected to go on with it this prep after going out a winner when saluting in good style over 1200m at Cowra on March 9. Has shown enough in her two trials to suggest a forward showing is expected. DUBAI ADVENTURE (2) Street Boss gelding having his first run for the Mitchell Beer & George Carpenter barn. Won well on debut, then finished a battling fifth over 1200m at Mornington last December. Ran sixth in a recent trial at Illawarra Grange over 800m. Can pull out a big run fresh from the low gate. AUGUST RUSH (6) returns from a let-up. First-up after five months he led throughout for a slick Maiden win over 1100m at Port Macquarie. Don't dismiss in this stronger contest.
